title: Devil's Motorcycle Nightmare
description: A surreal blue-toned scene shows a terrified screaming face with wide eyes on the left, a red devil riding a glowing motorcycle leaping across a broken stone bridge in the center, and a blue horned demon with glowing purple butterflies below. The background features ruined gothic arches, ravens, a full moon, and a circular zodiac-like symbol behind the face.
prompt: Surreal nightmare scene on lined notebook paper, a giant terrified screaming blue face with wide eyes and lightning bolts on the left inside a glowing zodiac circle, a bright red devil with horns riding a blue and red motorcycle with headlight on jumping a broken stone bridge, blue horned demon with glowing hands and purple butterflies below, ruined gothic arches, ravens flying, full moon, dark fantasy atmosphere, dramatic lighting, detailed linework
